$comment: M4b §A.2. The fixed motif vocabulary. Every card in every deck may carry `tags.motifs`: one to three of these words (zero is allowed for a card with no image in it). The validator rejects anything not on this list and reports per-deck coverage; the engine scores a card by how many of its motifs the page's motif set already holds. Nothing outside this file may add a word: a vocabulary that grows to fit the cards stops being a vocabulary. A card that fights it is a note in docs/08-tagging-notes.md, not a new motif.
$groups: The groups are for the writer's eye and for the engine's two special cases: `weather` motifs are the ones that agree or disagree with the night, and `props` motifs are the ones the glue templates (§A.6) may carry into the next line as a noun.
